page.layout: One printed page. Running head "De Cetis." at top centre with page number 161 at top right. Below it, two engraved illustrations side by side: left a dolphin with a foetus, with its caption above it; right a larger dolphin picture with its caption above it. No running text. Signature mark at lower right of the right figure.

main_text.l: Delphinus fœmina cum fœtu masculo, ut Rondeletius exhibuit.
Alia Delphini pictura, quam à Corn. Sittardo habui.

page.notes: The page carries two woodcut illustrations of dolphins, no running text. The left caption is set in two lines (the second line "Rondeletius exhibuit."). The signature "O 3" is printed at the lower right of the right-hand figure, a gathering mark. Captions are in italic type.
